output.scope_note: The paper is a computational proposal (DFT) for radical-anion-functionalized h-BN cathode/electrolyte materials; its only Li-ion conductivity numbers (0.2 mS/cm, 0.647 mS/cm) are for h-BN composite pastes and ion gels containing liquid electrolyte, not solid Li/Na conductors, and the proposed material's ionic conductivity is not measured or quantified.
